events.subtitle_en: Sweet, savoury — or both? No judgement.
events.venue_zh: 深圳之眼购物中心 西区2号中庭
events.venue_en: Shenzhen Eye Shopping Centre — West Zone, Atrium 2
events.summary_en: Four days only. Street snacks from every corner of China, sweet and savoury in one place — plus live music, stamp collecting for prizes, and lawn games including bowling and ring toss.
highlights_en: Tastings from across the country, sweet and savoury side by side
Live music performances
Collect stamps across the venue for a prize draw
Interactive games: bowling, ring toss, shuttlecock kicking

events.subtitle_en: 60+ bakeries and coffee shops from across Asia
events.venue_zh: 深圳湾万象城 B区广场
events.venue_en: MixC Shenzhen Bay — Zone B Plaza
events.summary_en: A National Day feast of carbs: more than 60 popular bakeries and cafés from across Asia, celebrity baker appearances, and the Kaleidoscope Award ranking of Asia's top ten breads. Eat as you wander, and catch the sunset over the bay.
highlights_en: 60+ bakeries and coffee shops from across Asia
Celebrity bakers hosting in person
Kaleidoscope Award — Asia's Top 10 Breads list
Sunset views over Shenzhen Bay

events.subtitle_en: 'Wushiliu' sounds like 'nothing to do' — so come and wander
events.venue_zh: 光明大仟里 A区 L1 中庭
events.venue_en: Guangming Uni-Mall (Da Qian Li) — Zone A, L1 Atrium
events.summary_en: The third edition brings 50 selected brands to Guangming for the National Day holiday — pour-over speciality coffee, inventive signature drinks, baked goods, teas, and handmade crafts. The name is a pun on 'nothing to do', so the idea is simply to come and wander.
highlights_en: 50 selected exhibitors
Speciality pour-over and creative signature drinks
Baked goods and specialist teas
Arts, crafts and handmade goods

events.title_en: miffy café — First in South China
events.title_zh: 华南首家 miffy café 主题店
events.venue_zh: 深圳 K11 ECOAST 南馆 & 北馆 L3 连廊
events.venue_en: K11 ECOAST — South & North Halls, L3 Link Bridge

events.summary_en: South China's first miffy café opens at K11 ECOAST and runs for two months. Limited-edition menu items and merchandise join a large miffy inflatable that has already appeared at the development's Pearl of the Sea art installation.
highlights_en: First miffy café in South China
miffy character appearances on opening day
Exclusive menu and limited merchandise
Large miffy inflatable at the Pearl of the Sea installation

30+ champions and city-level top baristas
Nearly 25 international and Chinese champions attending
